name: Rigged Rope Bridge (CR 2)
body:
Rigged Rope Bridge
CR 2

XP 600

Source: Pathfinder 1: Burnt Offerings

Type mechanical; Perception DC 15; Disable Device DC 15

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset manual

Effect 80-foot fall into water (2d3 non-lethal plus 4d6 lethal); multiple targets (all creatures on rope bridge); DC 13 Reflex save avoids.
